mustFix.problem: Captions and alt text describe photographs that are not rendered
mustFix.fix: Until real media lands, drop the caption strips and mark the placeholder imgs alt="" aria-hidden so the panels are pure reading chips; restore descriptive alts with the real frames

elevate.move: Make photography part of the instrument: each story photo carries its reading chip under a teal comfort-band duotone while out of band and clears to full colour as the dot enters the band, so the photo dries out as the reading improves

Compose the hero as one instrument panel: headline across the top, chart and dials dominant, lead/proof/actions as a readout column aligned to the chart's top and bottom rules with the live dew point repeated large, and the primary button carrying the visitor's reading
